lines.text: Many learners say: I will call you when I will arrive.
Better: I will call you when I arrive.
After when, use arrive. No will.
Get! Call me when you get home.

data.wrong: I will call you when I will arrive.
data.right: I will call you when I arrive.
data.why: After when, use arrive. No will.

native.tip: when 引导的时间从句，即使说将来的事，也用一般现在时。

en.tip: In a clause with when, use the present tense even for the future.
en.caption: Do you say “I will call you when I will arrive.”? 😅 After when, use the present tense even for the future: “I will call you when I arrive.”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
